newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish foreign debt up to $75.757 billion in H1.
newsitem.headline: Turkish foreign debt up to $75.757 billion in H1.

text.p: Turkey's outstanding foreign debt in H1 rose to $75.757 billion from $72.093 billion in Q1 and $73.278 billion at end-1995, the treasury said on Thursday.
It said $57.238 billion of the total debt in H1 was from medium- and long-term borrowings, the rest being short-term debts.
Debts of public intitutions accounted for $49.239 billion of the total long-and medium-term debt stock, while the private sector debts stood at $7.999 billion.
The central bank said on Thursday Turkey had serviced $7.032 billion of its total debts including principal and interest so far this year.
